bookings_cancellation_fields_valid.name: bookings_cancellation_fields_valid
bookings_cancellation_fields_valid.value:
(status = 'cancelled')
             OR (
                 cancelled_at IS NULL
                 AND cancellation_reason IS NULL
             )

court_operating_hours_valid_time.name: court_operating_hours_valid_time
court_operating_hours_valid_time.value:
(is_closed = true)
             OR (
                 is_closed = false
                 AND start_time IS NOT NULL
                 AND end_time IS NOT NULL
                 AND start_time < end_time
             )

facilities_latitude_valid.name: facilities_latitude_valid
facilities_latitude_valid.value:
latitude IS NULL
             OR latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90

facilities_longitude_valid.name: facilities_longitude_valid
facilities_longitude_valid.value:
longitude IS NULL
             OR longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180

payments_paid_at_consistency.name: payments_paid_at_consistency
payments_paid_at_consistency.value:
(status = 'success' AND paid_at IS NOT NULL)
             OR
             (status <> 'success')
